concordantmodes documentation
=============================

This program utilizes the Concordant Modes theoretical framework to compute
highly accurate Hessians with linear scaling. The CMA protocol is detailed in
the literature (*J. Am. Chem. Soc.*, 2022, **144**, 51, 23271–23274;
*J. Chem. Theory Comput.*, 2024, **20**, 24, 10886–10898; *J Phys Chem A.* 2026 Apr 13;**130**(16):3249–3260).
